name: hod-mods core
summary: The hook hub every section builds on, the runtime switches, the collision lock and crash guard, the shared enemy hurt-box feed, the Enchanted-row card icon, the recomp patch and the shared tools.

exe_sources: core/runtime/hod_hub.cpp (chains, registration, collision lock; links into test harnesses)
core/runtime/hod_overrides.cpp (the one definition of each shared guest function)
core/runtime/equip_card_icon.cpp (compiled when familiars or nathan is: card icon for Alucard's and Nathan's Enchanted row)

own_behaviour.823C4C40 / 823C5098: every collision shape registration and list traversal runs under one recursive lock (enemies register on several game threads)
own_behaviour.823C4EC8: rejects stale or sentinel collision requests before the game's filter reads them (a Medusa Shield crash)
own_behaviour.823E0410, 823E6958, 823EA810, 823ED418,: Enchanted-row card icon for character IDs 2 (familiars on) and 12 (nathan on)

edits_outside_package.change: Card icon frames 180 (palette 6) and 181 (palette 7, dimmed) in the page's empty strip (rows 96-127); the drawing is core/art/equip_slot/card_slot_icon_source.png

changes.src/CMakeLists.txt: HODMODS_ROOT cache variable; includes core/cmake/hodmods.cmake, adds its sources, calls hodmods_configure_targets(). Without HODMODS_ROOT the build is stock.
changes.src/scripts/build.py: mods/<package>/ folders are built like DLC packages (code modules recompiled)
changes.src/src/dlc.cpp: package files whose names are longer than 42 characters no longer get deleted and re-extracted on every launch (reported upstream: core/recomp/BUG_DLC_LONG_FILENAMES.md)
changes.src/src/harmonyrecomp_app.h: a test-install exe (HARMONYRECOMP_POISONWORM) always uses the userdata folder next to it

tools.hodpaths.py: where the game, the work folder, the test install and every tool and setting are
tools.setup_recomp.py: prepare a stock v0.6.0 recomp tree (with backup and --restore)
tools.rebuild_recomp.py: configure and build the exe with chosen sections
tools.hooks_table.py: regenerate core/hooks.json and docs/HOOKS.md from the sources
tools.check_native.py: compile (and optionally link) every native source with the recomp's own flags, without touching the recomp tree
tools.check_tools.py: parse, path and import checks for every Python tool
tools.check_repo.py: no game files, large binaries, local paths or personal names
tools.hod_musicpack.py: the LIVE STFS package writer every section's installer uses (also the music pack builder)
tools.shared libraries: txrc.py (text), hodsprite.py (OPD/CSR/COL), sheet2hod.py, ndsfs.py (NDS file system), sotn_disc.py (SotN disc reader), cotm_extract.py / cotm_sprites.py / nathan_paths.py (CotM ROM extraction), xex*.py (XEX unpack, rebase, patch), overlap.py, dlcslots.py
tools.research aids: hod_disasm.py, moddisasm.py, xref.py, relsearch.py, lzscan.py, shotinfo.py, render_tpf.py, dumpguest.py, guestwatch.py, drawscan.py, enemyprobe.py, soundheap.py (read-only)
